newsitem.title: USA: Old Kent completes Seaway acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Old Kent completes Seaway acquisition.

text.p: Old Kent Financial Corp said Tuesday it completed its acquisition of Seaway Financial Corp effective January 1.
On June 4, Old Kent said the deal was worth $74 million.

Seaway is a bank holding company headquartered in St. Clair, Mich., with assets of $362 million as of September 30. It is the parent company of the Commercial and Savings Bank of St. Clair County and Algonac Savings Bank.
Old Kent is a bank holding company with more than 200 full-service offices in Michigan and Illinois and $12.5 billion in assets as of September 30.
